notes.title: v8.0.12
notes.content:
[h1]Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Volume system (db to float) min 0.0, max 1.0
[*] Tower place tutorial enemy bomb audio
[*] Tower disable sound added
[*] Guide menu spelling errors
[*] Starting game splash screen crash on input press
[*] Tutorial toggles off hardcore & turbo buttons
[/list]

[h1]Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Button / panel themes unified
[*] Menu layouts reworked
[*] Achievements show 5 items per row
[*] Profile select show 3 items per row
[*] Towers: enemy targeting improved
[*] Increased "Multi-Task Trouble" start RAM to 2k
[*] Pause game with "Escape" / "Start" gamepad button
[*] Select tower type with WASD / Arrows / DPad
(bug: sometimes tower select buttons loose focus, click a tower button & selection will work again)
[*] Place towers with left click / down face button (A)
[*] Fix towers with R / top face button (Y)
[*] Sell towers with E / right face button (B)
[/list]

notes.title: v9.0.01 Player Stats and Fixer Tweaks
notes.content:
[b]Added Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam high score is now shown when playing a level ( in the Achievement tab )
[*] Level name is also shown when playing a level ( in the Achievement tab )
[*] Achievement stats [ Enemies_Deleted, Data, Ram ] are saved to Steam player stats
[*] Enemies_Deleted, Data, and Ram stats are unified across Windows, Mac, and Linux
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes / Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixing towers doesn't cost data when wave is finished / enemies aren't spawning
[*] Fixing towers when they're at max health doesn't keep spending data
[/list]
